titulo: A CARTA QUE NÃO ERA PARA ELA
personagens: Debora, a woman around 28 with short wavy black hair and a mint dress; her boyfriend, a man around 30 with curly red hair and a sweater; his parents in their 60s
cenario: a cozy apartment and the boyfriend's parents' home
cenas: Debora reading a letter describing a beach, a storm and an airport, puzzled
Debora opening an anniversary gift box with a letter inside
Debora comparing the letter with an old family photograph of a beach trip
Debora finding a box of old papers belonging to the boyfriend's mother
Debora holding the letter and the photo, wondering
The boyfriend realizing he grabbed the wrong envelope, embarrassed
The boyfriend and Debora laughing awkwardly at the mix-up
Debora returning the old letter to the boyfriend's parents, who smile with nostalgia
Debora reading a short sincere handwritten note from the boyfriend a week later
Debora and the boyfriend hugging on a balcony at sunset
